topic: What beamforming techniques optimize spatial overlap between local oscillator and quantum signal in free-space homodyne detection under atmospheric distortion?
consensus_response: In free-space homodyne detection, Analog Beamforming (ABF) is the most effective technique for optimizing spatial overlap between the local oscillator and quantum signal under atmospheric distortion. ABF dynamically adjusts the phase and amplitude of the local oscillator to compensate for distortions, ensuring optimal alignment with the quantum signal. This approach leverages the flexibility of ABF to adapt to changing environmental conditions, thereby minimizing noise and maximizing detection efficiency.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of robustness against background noise in free-space homodyne detection, with CV-QKD being more robust than DV-QKD due to its ability to efficiently measure both quadrature operators simultaneously.
